name: us-family-activities-by-metro
title: Family activities by U.S. metro area (Grassy Knees)
description: Weekly per-metro counts of kids' and family activities listed on Grassy Knees (grassyknees.com) across 42 U.S. metropolitan areas: listings that have not ended, dated events in the next 30 days and how many are free, classes and programs, places, the mix of activity types, the median published ticket price of paid events, and how many towns have listings. Every listing is researched from the organizer's own page and re-checked on a daily research run. Totals only: the table never contains individual listings. Counts describe what Grassy Knees lists, not every event in a metro.

sources.title: U.S. Census Bureau, Metropolitan and Micropolitan Statistical Areas Population Totals (metro_population)

resources.name: family-activities-by-metro
resources.title: Latest snapshot
resources.description: One row per metro area, refreshed weekly from https://grassyknees.com/data/family-activities-by-metro.csv. Dated copies are kept in data/snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.csv with the same columns.

fields.name: metro_id
fields.title: Metro ID
fields.description: Grassy Knees metro identifier. The metro page is https://grassyknees.com/<metro_id>.

fields.name: metro
fields.title: Metro area
fields.description: Metropolitan statistical area name as used by the U.S. Census Bureau (e.g. New York–Newark–Jersey City).

fields.name: states
fields.title: States
fields.description: Postal codes of the states the metro area spans, separated by " / ".

fields.name: metro_population
fields.title: Metro population
fields.description: Metro area population from the U.S. Census Bureau population estimates.

fields.name: listings_current
fields.title: Current listings
fields.description: Public events, classes/programs and places in the metro that have not ended.

fields.name: events_next_30_days
fields.title: Events, next 30 days
fields.description: Dated events taking place in the next 30 days.

fields.name: free_events_next_30_days
fields.title: Free events, next 30 days
fields.description: Events in the next 30 days that are free to attend.

fields.name: free_share_pct
fields.title: Free share (%)
fields.description: free_events_next_30_days / events_next_30_days, as a whole percentage. Empty when there are no upcoming events.

fields.name: programs
fields.title: Programs
fields.description: Current listings that are classes, camps or multi-session programs.

fields.name: places
fields.title: Places
fields.description: Current listings that are places to visit (museums, parks, rinks, play spaces) rather than dated events.

fields.name: outdoors
fields.title: Outdoors
fields.description: Current listings in the Outdoors category.

fields.name: arts_and_crafts
fields.title: Arts & crafts
fields.description: Current listings in the Arts & crafts category.

fields.name: stem_and_discovery
fields.title: STEM & discovery
fields.description: Current listings in the STEM & discovery category.

fields.name: sports_and_play
fields.title: Sports & play
fields.description: Current listings in the Sports & play category.

fields.name: community
fields.title: Community
fields.description: Current listings in the Community category (festivals, library and community events).

fields.name: cooking
fields.title: Cooking
fields.description: Current listings in the Cooking category.

fields.name: other
fields.title: Other
fields.description: Current listings in no other category. The seven category columns sum to listings_current.

fields.name: median_paid_event_price_usd
fields.title: Median paid ticket (USD)
fields.description: Median published price of paid events in the next 30 days, as the organizer lists it (usually one child's ticket). Empty when no paid event has a price.

fields.name: towns_with_listings
fields.title: Towns with listings
fields.description: Distinct towns and neighborhoods in the current listings' addresses.

fields.name: last_checked
fields.title: Last checked
fields.description: Latest date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which a listing in the metro was checked against the organizer's page.

resources.name: family-activities-by-metro-json
resources.title: Latest snapshot (JSON)
resources.description: The same rows as the CSV, wrapped with title, description, license, credit, lastChecked and generated fields, as published at https://grassyknees.com/data/family-activities-by-metro.json.
